meta.description: Deterministic CRM segment + lifecycle thresholds for LaundryKhalas. Backend rules only (services/crm_segments.py). No LLM assigns these.

customer_tiers._note: Backend-computed loyalty tier (New/Repeat/Bronze/Silver/Gold) from LEGITIMATE completed orders only (the repo excludes drafts/cancelled/refunded/test when gathering facts). A customer meets a tier when EITHER the completed-order count OR the lifetime completed value reaches the tier's minimum; precedence is highest-tier-first. Configurable per market; never hardcoded in the prompt and never assigned by the LLM.

notes.repeat_customer: confirmed_order_count >= repeat_min_confirmed_orders (two or more separate confirmed booking cycles).
notes.price_sensitive: discount_request_count >= price_sensitive_min_discount_requests OR price_enquiry_count >= price_sensitive_min_price_enquiries (without a confirmed booking).
notes.inactive: no confirmed booking or meaningful activity within inactive_days.
notes.campaign_responder: confirmed booking within campaign_attribution_days of a campaign send (wired in the campaign-attribution slice).
